factory_owns: completion audit and Receipt Five preparation
user_must_not_do: poll the bot repeatedly for status
decide method internals without a bounded approval request
approval_points: Product SOT approval when material scope is unresolved
architecture approval when risk or cost is material
access approval when credentials or accounts are required
release approval for production or irreversible promotion
final acceptance after evidence and review

batch_when: multiple preference decisions can be answered together
status updates are informational and do not change authority
non-urgent review notes can be summarized after the worker batch
auto_resolve_when: discoverable information can be found in source material, Hermes, repo files or worker outputs
internal coordination belongs to the factory, including worker packets, schemas, routing and gate reports
worker evidence can be produced by a registered non-human worker
non-human blockers have a factory-owned repair route, retry budget and fresh review path
operator_interrupt_policy.status_reporting: Push progress, blockers and proof proactively without asking for action unless a listed interrupt condition is active.

autonomy_modes.plain_meaning: The factory may organize sources, plans and questions, but cannot execute material work.
The factory may move quickly on reversible low-risk work with budget, rollback and stop conditions.
A stricter disposable lane for throwaway diagnostics or experiments, not product authority.
Normal gated worker execution inside the approved card scope.
Higher-stakes implementation that needs stronger proof and review before completion.
Operational production work; never a default autonomous lane.

handoff_mode: compressed operator view with understanding, bounded decisions, blockers, proof and next action
blocked_state_policy: stop with a named blocker, owner, evidence needed and smallest safe next action instead of pushing open-ended work to the user

factory_work: classify input and start source resolution

allowed_user_work: approve or reject material scope and risk decisions
factory_work: create Product SOT, route methods, research and plans
route workers, run checks, capture evidence and review

allowed_user_work: approve high-risk release or risk acceptance
factory_work: prepare promotion evidence, rollback and monitoring
reconcile Receipt Five and completion audit

surface_map.normal_user_view: bounded approval request with scope, risk and evidence
